item.title: Mise
item.author: xxxx
item.description:
Mise
https://mise.jdx.dev/
Your dev env,already prepped. One tool to manage languages, env vars, and tasks per project, reproducibly.

Everything in its place, before you code.
In a professional kitchen, mise en place is the ritual of prep: knives sharpened, onions diced, stock warm, station clean. The work before the work.
mise does the same for your dev env. It activates the right language versions, loads the right env vars, and wires up the right tasks for the commands you run.

item.author: xxxx
item.description:
oha
https://github.com/hatoo/oha
Ohayou(おはよう), HTTP load generator, inspired by rakyll/hey with tui animation.

This program is written in Rust and powered by tokio and beautiful tui by ratatui.

item.title: Hey
item.author: xxxx
item.description:
Hey
https://github.com/rakyll/hey

hey is a tiny program that sends some load to a web application.

hey was originally called boom and was influenced from Tarek Ziade’s tool at tarekziade/boom.

Using the same name was a mistake as it resulted in cases where binary name conflicts created confusion.
To preserve the name for its original owner, we renamed this project to hey.

Previously known as github.com/rakyll/boom.

item.title: Qodana
item.author: xxxx
item.description:
Qodana
https://www.jetbrains.com/qodana/
Code quality done right

Static code analysis by Qodana helps development teams follow agreed quality standards, and deliver readable, maintainable, and secure code. Powered by JetBrains.

* 2,500+ code checks
Use Qodana’s extensive inspection portfolio to spot performance issues, probable bugs, unused declarations, confusing code constructs, violations of naming and style conventions, and much more.

* Third-party license audit
Detect when third-party libraries and framework licenses used by your application are incompatible with your application’s license and cannot be used for a commercial project.

item.description:
Eclipse Theia
https://theia-ide.org/
Cloud & Desktop IDE Platform
Eclipse Theia is an extensible platform to develop multi-language Cloud & Desktop IDEs with state-of-the-art web technologies.

Repo: https://github.com/eclipse-theia/theia

Cloud & Desktop

Not sure whether you need a web or desktop version or both?

With Theia you can develop one IDE and run it in browsers or native desktop application from a single source.

Vendor Neutral

The Theia project is hosted at the Eclipse Foundation, a not-for-profit corporation, and is developed by a diverse community.
